title: SafeStart: Mitigating the Overlooked Safety Cost of Active Expert Reduction in MoE LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2611.06147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models send each token through a few of many expert subnetworks. Serving methods make these models faster by running even fewer experts per token, and they are validated on accuracy benchmarks. We show that these methods can weaken the model's refusal of harmful requests, and we introduce SafeStart, which largely restores refusal while keeping most of the speedup. In vLLM on one RTX A6000, keeping about two thirds of the selected experts speeds up offline decoding by 15 to 28% at batch size 8. We find that, at this setting, under a jailbreak that tells the model not to refuse, the share of harmful requests that the model answers rises by 18.4 percentage points on Qwen1.5-MoE, 9.5 on OLMoE, and 6.6 on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, the three of nine models where it rises significantly, while MMLU accuracy drops by less than two points. We discover that most of this increase arises while the model processes the prompt

translated_title: SafeStart：缓解MoE大语言模型服务中主动专家削减所带来的被忽视的安全成本
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06147v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：混合专家模型将每个token仅通过众多专家子网络中的少数几个进行处理。现有的服务加速方法通过让每个token经过更少的专家来提升推理速度，并通常在准确率基准上进行验证。我们展示了这些方法会削弱模型对有害请求的拒绝能力，并提出了SafeStart，它在保留大部分加速效果的同时，能够大幅恢复模型的拒绝能力。在单张RTX A6000上使用vLLM的实验中，保留约三分之二的被选中专家可在batch size为8时将离线解码速度提升15%到28%。我们发现，在此设置下，在一种指示模型不要拒绝的越狱攻击下，模型回答的有害请求比例在Qwen1.5-MoE上上升18.4个百分点，在OLMoE上上升9.5个百分点，在DeepSeek-V2-Lite上上升6.6个百分点（这是九个测试模型中显著上升的三个），而MMLU准确率下降不到2分。我们还发现，这种上升大部分发生在模型处理提示词的阶段。
tldr: 本文揭示了MoE大模型服务中减少激活专家数量的加速方法会削弱模型对有害请求的拒绝能力，并提出SafeStart方法，在保留大部分加速效果的同时大幅恢复模型的安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that expert reduction methods for accelerating MoE LLM serving weaken the model's refusal of harmful requests, and proposes SafeStart, which largely restores safety while retaining most of the speedup.
